per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to routine interactions (browsing, searching, loading movie details) within 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete checkout processes within 15 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall ensure initial buffering for streaming content is within single-digit seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall encrypt card data at rest and implement role-based access controls for sensitive data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall detect and block suspicious traffic, including credential stuffing, scraping, and DDoS attacks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide a clear and visible privacy notice, including a banner or modal before collecting sensitive data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement centralized logs, dashboards, and alerts for key health metrics.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement role-based UIs that are simple and lightweight for reviewer workflows.
The system shall implement a microservices approach, CDN for static/streaming, and container orchestration to handle load spikes.
The system shall ensure customer trust is protected through secure handling of payments, privacy, and reliability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All customer information will be stored on a secure database accessible only to authorized personnel.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall have a UI that is forgiving for non-power users, with big buttons, simple language, and an African-inspired aesthetic.
